# C test suite inventory

The tests the rewrite is scored on: `tests/data/testNNNN` driven by `tests/runtests.pl`, the libtest/unit/tunit C programs they invoke, the `tests/http` pytest suite and the test servers. Parsed with a port of `tests/getpart.pm` (line based, bytes read as latin-1, CRLF folded as `runtests.pl` does). `runtests.pl` finds tests by listing `tests/data` for `^test[0-9]+$` files and subtracting `tests/data/DISABLED`; `tests/data/Makefile.am` is only checked for a warning. Full per-test records are in `tests.json`.

## perf benchmarks (`tests/perf`)

Stand-alone programs in one `perf` binary that time a function in a loop; not run by `runtests.pl`. `c-abi` ones use only the public API and can run against any libcurl; `port` ones call internal helpers and need a Rust counterpart, like the unit tests.

| program | Rust leg | public API | internal measured | usage |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| base64dec | port | curl_mfprintf, curl_mprintf | curlx_base64_decode | `./perf base64dec [loops]` |
| base64enc | port | curl_mfprintf, curl_mprintf | curlx_base64_encode | `./perf base64enc [loops]` |
| dateparser | c-abi | curl_getdate, curl_mfprintf, curl_mprintf | - | `./perf dateparser [loops]` |
| maprintf | c-abi | curl_free, curl_maprintf, curl_mfprintf, curl_mprintf | - | `./perf maprintf [loops]` |
| numparser | port | curl_mprintf | curlx_str_hex, curlx_str_octal | `./perf numparser [loops]` |
| simpleformat | c-abi | curl_mprintf, curl_msnprintf | - | `./perf simpleformat [loops]` |
| snprintf | c-abi | curl_mprintf, curl_msnprintf | - | `./perf snprintf [loops]` |
| urldecode | c-abi | curl_easy_unescape, curl_free, curl_mfprintf, curl_mprintf, curl_msnprintf | - | `./perf urldecode [loops]` |
| urlencode | c-abi | curl_easy_escape, curl_free, curl_mfprintf, curl_mprintf | - | `./perf urlencode [loops]` |
| urlparser | c-abi | curl_mfprintf, curl_mprintf, curl_url, curl_url_cleanup, curl_url_set | - | `./perf urlparser URLs.txt [loops]` |

## Test servers

C programs in `tests/server`, all built into one `servers` bundle and launched as `servers <name>` by the Perl drivers or by `servers.pm` directly:

| program | file | long options |
|---|---|---|
| dnsd | tests/server/dnsd.c | --ipv4, --ipv6, --logdir, --logfile, --pidfile, --port, --portfile, --verbose, --version |
| mqttd | tests/server/mqttd.c | --config, --ipv4, --ipv6, --logdir, --logfile, --pidfile, --port, --portfile, --version |
| resolve | tests/server/resolve.c | --ipv4, --ipv6, --version |
| rtspd | tests/server/rtspd.c | --ipv4, --ipv6, --logdir, --logfile, --pidfile, --port, --portfile, --srcdir, --version |
| sockfilt | tests/server/sockfilt.c | --addr, --bindonly, --connect, --ipv4, --ipv6, --logfile, --pidfile, --port, --portfile, --verbose, --version |
| socksd | tests/server/socksd.c | --backend, --backendport, --config, --ipv4, --ipv6, --logfile, --pidfile, --port, --portfile, --reqfile, --unix-socket, --version |
| sws | tests/server/sws.c | --cmdfile, --connect, --gopher, --ipv4, --ipv6, --keepalive, --logdir, --logfile, --pidfile, --port, --portfile, --srcdir, --unix-socket, --version |
| tftpd | tests/server/tftpd.c | --ipv4, --ipv6, --logdir, --logfile, --pidfile, --port, --portfile, --srcdir, --version |
